* 4e457b406b1c8001cba2bc9bf3387d8304d677d7 MUL-8968: fix(issues): one meaning for "my agents' work" across filters and sidebar (#10310)
* eea447533421882c84dc9db791a151c05cc968b8 MUL-8969: feat: subscribe to every issue in a project (#10303)
* 33137e6f6bf01bd371b8626e7adb927ff2d39e77 MUL-8977 feat(telegram): show what the agent is doing while it works (#10314)

* c3a9d8fd1e460f9cf79be7160f19cd1a12624332 MUL-8992: fix(server): keep background runs and workspace-wide reads inside private projects (#10329)
* 018107609d5f00a3be6b86d38e3babe2e0e164a1 MUL-8992: fix(tasks): resolve runs to their private project before showing or stopping them (#10317)
* 0270a1d51ac36fe5670b5aa290e877c2f1a511f8 MUL-9004: fix(chat): remove customize-starters link from chat empty state (#10342)
* d1217a149812ff34410cdf49d3b2dc7d030b1b03 MUL-9012 refactor(chat): floating ChatWindow runs on useChatController (#10392)
* fe984c64e31e3eb1441478b0951bd7ded4b0854a MUL-9015: feat(transcript): show command tool input line by line (#10413)
* 1dd5bcf25c5e7caccc64ff725ee4dd629f9f243d MUL-9019 refactor(labels): skills reuse LabelPicker with inline create; manage labels only in Settings (#10385)
* 5894f11a95fa5d3c582cc4e2263fa77e7a283993 MUL-9021: return GitHub connections to the original page with repositories preselected (#10363)
* ac2ac4013ddf0402348bf19ba41151bf662adf21 MUL-9028: feat(cli): rewrite body links to same-call attachments (#10362)
* d28b5cbc41f3c8d511948e0af881ba73cea4a070 MUL-9034: fix(appearance): theme check measures contrast at every select and toggle value (#10365)
* 7ebafbb072acaad53fc68fceb38e833c7f540260 MUL-9036 fix(theme): store previews use the same component aliases as the app (#10371)
* ad9e7dd3e1fa0abfe3ffd6065407c5dbc6db710b MUL-9037: feat(comments): show comment images as thumbnails, with a setting for full size (#10372)
* 23b4821ca73ad9e257363554f78d2c14a1af80e3 MUL-9039: test(cli): stop the dev-env daemon profile test probing the real hashed port (#10370)
